reason: I already pay a setter and it works well enough, and I'm not putting my main Instagram account into a Chrome extension from a product with 7 seats sold and zero customer results. $147 isn't the issue, a restricted account is.
objection: Will this get my Instagram restricted or banned? Nobody has published results, and a 3-day trial with the card up front isn't enough time to find out, since a ban or a throttle can show up weeks later. Plus I can't tell if it actually beats my setter.
would_change_my_mind: Real agency owners showing booked calls and months of sending with no restrictions, or a trial long enough (14 days) to run it on a throwaway account first.
